title: Decision tree evaluation on Boolean inputs
statement: For a decision tree on $n$ coordinates and an input $x\in(\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z)^n$, its value is the stored sign at a leaf. At a node querying coordinate $i$, it evaluates the zero child if $x_i=0$ and the one child otherwise.
